name: gpstracker
description: Sistema de rastreo GPS en tiempo real multiplataforma (Android/iOS/Web) sobre AWS serverless

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @gps/web && npm run build -w @gps/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p services/backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit false --outDir services/backend/dist && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p infra/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build:shared && npm run deploy -w @gps/infra
